notes.title: SLEEP AWAKE will be launching in 2026!
notes.content:
SLEEP AWAKE will be launching in 2026!


Just announced in the Future Games Show, SLEEP AWAKE will be launching next year. But if you join the Blumhouse Games Discord, you'll find out when you can play it sooner.
